plan.title: Rejected Bids available on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids, as required for this case.
Ensure the required eRFX project configuration is enabled for the tenant.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Assert that Rejected Bids is offered and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Click Rejected Bids to open its window.
Confirm that the Rejected Bids window opened.
Cancel the window so no bid state is changed.
Confirm after cancellation that the action remains offered and enabled.
